The latest update changes this by forcing aggregation of all mutual fund investments from every platform (Zerodha, Groww, etc.), which I really don’t like. This “all-in-one view” adds unwanted noise. I already check other apps for my external holdings—why complicate Kuvera by mixing them in? Now, my portfolio view is bloated with investments I didn’t make through Kuvera, making it harder to quickly see what matters: my direct investments on this platform. My request is straightforward: bring back two separate views. One for “All Investments” (if you want aggregation), and one for “Kuvera-only” (my preferred default). text: Some of my observations - केवल अल्पकालिक डेटा पर ज़ोर SIP एक दीर्घकालिक निवेश रणनीति है। वीडियो में हाल के कुछ वर्षों के रिटर्न्स को देखकर SIP को कमज़ोर बताया गया है, जो सही नहीं है। बाजार चक्रों की अनदेखी वीडियो में कहा गया है कि SIP रिटर्न्स लगातार गिरते रहेंगे। लेकिन शेयर बाजार में उतार-चढ़ाव सामान्य है। मंदी के बाद तेजी आती ही है। महंगाई और वास्तविक रिटर्न्स का ज़िक्र नहीं वीडियो में महंगाई के प्रभाव को स्पष्ट रूप से नहीं समझाया गया है, जिससे रिटर्न्स की सही तस्वीर नहीं मिलती। निवेशक व्यवहार की अनदेखी कई बार निवेशक डरकर बीच में ही निवेश बंद कर देते हैं, जिससे रिटर्न्स प्रभावित होते हैं। यह पहलू वीडियो में नहीं बताया गया। भय फैलाने वाला संदेश “रिटर्न्स गिरते रहेंगे” जैसे वाक्य निवेशकों में अनावश्यक डर पैदा कर सकते हैं, जो दीर्घकालिक निवेश के लिए नुकसानदायक है। क्या सही है: कुछ SIP फंड्स के रिटर्न्स हाल में घटे हैं, जो बाज़ार की स्थिति, ब्याज दरों और वैश्विक अनिश्चितताओं के कारण हो सकता है। वीडियो में कुछ तथ्य हैं, लेकिन दृष्टिकोण एकतरफा और डर पैदा करने वाला है। SIP एक अनुशासित और दीर्घकालिक निवेश का माध्यम है, जिसे अल्पकालिक उतार-चढ़ाव से आंकना उचित नहीं।

text: Interesting video Akshat, but I think this analysis oversimplifies things a bit. SIP isn’t a trap — it’s a long-term wealth compounding tool used by some of the smartest minds in finance. If SIPs were really as ineffective as you suggest, do you think top fund houses like HDFC, Mirae, or even global legends like Warren Buffett would advocate for disciplined compounding and market participation? Also, inflation adjustment doesn’t mean you “lose” the value — it just reflects purchasing power. In real terms, ₹10K SIP for 30 years can still give 10x growth on purchasing power if you stay consistent. And one small thought — you often mention your consulting experience at BCG, which is great, but as someone from the investment banking world and with friends at BCG, I can tell you real financial depth comes from decades in the markets, not a few months or a short stint. Transactions Tracking and Payments Integration- Serious Issue. Kuvera is definitely has lots of gaps. After using Kuvera as direct MF platform for past 1 year (almost), I would like to highlight some serious issues. List below. 1) UPI integration is definitely not seamless. You are lucky, if there is a success. 30% it fails and you need to wait for reflection or initiate payment again. Kuvera doesn’t have proper tracking of UPI failures - instead you need to share all proofs for their support team to validate and complete the transactions. Leads to serious frustration- when your funds are in dark and status unknown. 2) When markets are highly volatile - avoid using Kuvera for MF investments. Even if you have success on the transaction, there is a possibility that your NAV is not of same day. Kuvera generally puts it back in BSEStar platform - which may be right, but for me I expected their platform to be resilient. Currently, stability is a serious issue. You lose if NaV is low for that day and Kuvera considers next days NaV. Also, to prove that your side of transactions are done perfectly - we need to share everything. In the digital world, I wouldn’t expect customer to keep on sharing proofs to Kuvera team to prove that transactions are correctly submitted. 3) Support team has some gap in understanding queries. Many a times, multiple emails has to be triggered to explain the scenario and finally you get a response - which is completely out of context. 4) I still struggle for transaction units which are lost through Kuvera - still don’t have a trace of what happened and kept proving that it’s missing. Analysis and response from support is definitely a concern. 5) Kuvera is still not in a matured state and would expect them to standardise their operations, support, stability, resilience and finally transactions tracking seamlessly. - all above are my experience. Maybe a different user might have better experience, but 1 year on platform - these concerns are definitely to be addressed by Kuvera
